_meta.seeds_note: No random numbers are drawn; all values are closed-form.
_meta.scope: Simulation / code / bookkeeping checks: closed-form link-budget arithmetic on published specification values and literature constants, plus run-time checks of quoted repo lines. No comparison against RF measurements; no radio was operated. Published RCS values are other groups' measurements, used only to bracket sigma.

definitions.kT0_dbm_per_hz: 10*log10(k*T0) + 30 with k from scipy.constants and T0 = 290 K.
definitions.snr_db: Radar equation, full-duty coherent integration over T: SNR = Pt Gt Gr lambda^2 sigma T / ((4 pi)^3 R^4 k T0 F L), evaluated as the dB sum of worked_example.terms; lambda = c/fc with c from scipy.constants.
definitions.snr_per_sample_db: snr_db - 10*log10(B*T): the SNR of one sample in bandwidth B.
definitions.closure_db: snr_db (dB sum) minus the same quantity evaluated in the linear domain.
definitions.rmax_m: Range where snr_db equals the threshold: 10**((SNR at 1 m - threshold)/40).
definitions.pd_exact_nonfluctuating: Square-law detection of a nonfluctuating target, one look: threshold = chi2.isf(Pfa, 2); Pd = ncx2.sf(threshold, 2, 2*SNR).
definitions.range_factor: Maximum-range ratio for an SNR change of dS dB: 10**(dS/40).
definitions.walk_hz: Doppler change over the dwell from constant radial acceleration a: 2*a*T/lambda.
definitions.fs_to_adc_noise_db_in_band_ideal_12bit_m: 20*log10(2)*12 + 10*log10(1.5) + 10*log10(MCR/B) with MCR = 245.76 MS/s (the earlier, superseded model: master clock rate is not the converter rate and converter noise is ignored).
definitions.leakage_ceiling_dbm: thermal_floor_dbm_in_band + fs_to_adc_noise_db_in_band - adc_noise_margin_db - PAPR, PAPR = ofdm_papr_db for OFDM cases and 0 for a constant-envelope CW tone. It follows from setting the RX gain so thermal noise sits margin dB above the input-referred ADC noise and keeping the leakage peak at or below full scale.
definitions.tx_noise_dbm_per_hz: -146 dBm/Hz + TX gain offset; offset = CW output power for cw_tone_max and (5 + PAPR) for ofdm_plus5dbm (assumptions.tx_noise_gain_scaling).
definitions.excess_over_thermal_db_at_1khz: (Pt - I) + L_pn(1 kHz) + rx_lo_independent_db - (kT0 + NF), with L_pn(1 kHz) = -91 dBc/Hz + 20*log10(fc/1 GHz). The Doppler bin width cancels, so it does not depend on T. Applies to the leakage's own range bin near zero delay.
definitions.reference_channel_residual_change_db: 10*log10(var_RXA + var_RXB) - 10*log10(var_TX + var_RXB): change of the phase-noise skirt on signal channel B after subtracting the phase measured on a coupled reference channel A with an independent LO.
definitions.required_complex_rate_hz: 2*(f_tip + f_body): complex slow-time sampling rate that keeps +/- the maximum Doppler inside one unaliased span.
definitions.slow_time_rate_hz: every_symbol: symbols per second of the numerology; one_symbol_per_slot: slots per second (NR, LTE); Wi-Fi rates hold only inside a packet.
definitions.leakage_to_echo_ratio_db: (Pt - I) - echo power, echo = Pt + 2G + 10log10(lambda^2) + sigma - 10log10((4pi)^3) - 40log10(R).
definitions.adc_noise_input_referred_dbm_per_hz: Fig.5 0 dBFS input at 30 dB gain + NSD (dBFS/Hz).
definitions.combined_required_isolation_db: max(adc_ds926_isolation_db, tx_noise_isolation_db) for one fc/case: the larger of the ADC-linearity requirement (DS926 main NSD) and the TX broadband-noise requirement. Phase noise, maximum operating input and loopback attenuation are not folded in.
definitions.binding: 'adc' when adc_ds926_isolation_db >= tx_noise_isolation_db, else 'tx_noise': which term sets combined_required_isolation_db.
definitions.max_operating_input_isolation_db: pt_avg_dbm + papr_db - x410_rx_max_operating_input (dBm): isolation that keeps the leakage peak at or below the X410 Table 13 maximum operating power.
definitions.required_isolation_db_if_ofdm_papr_appli: cw_tone_max rows only: pt_avg_dbm - (leakage_ceiling_dbm - ofdm_papr_db), i.e. the earlier calculation that also subtracted the OFDM PAPR for a CW tone. Kept for traceability; not the current model.
definitions.leakage_ceiling_dbm_at_best_nsd: leakage_ceiling_dbm evaluated with the DS926 noise-floor NSD (noise_floor_input_minus35dbfs, typical) instead of the main FIN 1.9 GHz value.
definitions.walk_over_bin: walk_hz / bin_hz = 2*a*T^2/lambda: Doppler walk over the dwell in units of one Doppler bin.
definitions.f_tip_hz_with_si_c: Same f_tip formula with c = scipy.constants.c (exact SI value).
definitions.payload_gbps: channels * rate_hz * bytes_per_sample * 8 / 1e9: IQ sample payload only, without packet or protocol overhead.
definitions.decimation: mcr_hz / rate_hz (integer_decimation is true when it is an integer to 1e-9).
definitions.is_consequence_of_assumption: true when the entry follows directly from the named assumption (assumption_id) by arithmetic, so it restates that assumption rather than adding a finding.
definitions.assumption_id: id of the entry in _meta.assumptions that the value follows from.
definitions.max_rpm_note_quotes: repo_quotes records (path, line, quote, sha256) that support tip_doppler_inputs.max_rpm_note.
definitions.max_rpm_docs_json_value_from_quote: rpm value attributed to docs/drone_specs_2026.json, parsed at run time from the quoted src/drones.py comment line.
definitions.relative_difference_from_quoted_c_ratio: c_used_for_formula_mps / report07_generator_c_mps - 1, with both constants parsed from the quoted lines; f_tip scales as fc/c, so this is the gap a c difference alone produces.
definitions.explanation_quotes: repo_quotes records for the report07 generator lines (rpm0, lam, R, f_rev, f_tip) and the elevation_sweep_md.py lines (lam, R, f_rev, f_tip) that repo_rotor_reference.note relies on.
definitions.complex_rate_exceeds_rj45_uhd_rate: bandwidth_hz (complex sample rate needed) > uhd_x410_rj45_streaming value.
definitions.temperature_grade (sources.ds926_zu2xdr_: DS926 Table 1 temperature-range column label for the FIN 3.5 GHz NSD row ('E and I' or 'M').
definitions.primary_locator_status (sources): 'could_not_verify' when the table number in locator could not be checked against the primary document.
definitions.checkable_locators (sources): openly accessible documents whose text was read verbatim for the same values: url, doc, locator and the quoted text.

assumptions.note: Total system loss L in the radar equation. Does not include the RF cable run that an outdoor setup needs (both radios are rated indoor use only); that cable loss is unknown.
Receiver noise bandwidth and range-bin size basis.

Planning threshold, the rounded Albersheim value for Pd 0.9 / Pfa 1e-06 / one look (the exact computed values are in constants.thresholds; the rounding is checked in constants.thresholds.albersheim_rounds_to_planning_threshold).

OFDM peak-to-average power ratio used only for OFDM cases. Subtracted from the ADC full scale as in the earlier calculation; the 3.01 dB crest factor (10*log10(2)) of the full-scale sine that defines dBFS is ignored, so this is conservative by up to 3.01 dB.
RX gain set so thermal noise sits this far above the ADC noise in band; the resulting noise-figure degradation is computed (constants.nf_degradation_db_at_margin).
Leaked TX broadband noise kept this far below the RX thermal density.

X410 Table 8 gives -146 dBm/Hz at the TX gain that yields 0 dBm for a 0 dBFS baseband signal. The density is assumed to rise dB-for-dB with gain. For a 0 dBFS CW tone at maximum output the offset is the CW output power; for an OFDM average of +5 dBm the gain must yield (5 + PAPR) dBm for a 0 dBFS tone, so the offset is 5 + PAPR. No NI document states this scaling.
X410 Table 7 phase noise is given at a 1 GHz carrier only; the ZBX uses 1-2 GHz IFs, so the true scaling is not documented.
RX LO phase noise assumed independent of and equal to TX phase noise (+3 dB). Whether TX and RX of one ZBX channel share a synthesizer could not be confirmed.
Quasi-monostatic antennas a short distance apart put the direct leakage at near-zero delay; the phase-noise rows apply to that bin only.

assumptions.value: ZU2xDR Table 1 applies to the X410 XCZU28DR
assumptions.note: DS926 Table 1 test conditions (2 GS/s external clock, -1 dBFS input, Tj 40 C) differ from the X410 (ZBX manual: ADC runs at approx. 3 GHz, IF 1-2 GHz; clocking inside the X410 not documented).
Main NSD for the ds926_nsd rows is the typical value at FIN 1.9 GHz (inside the 1-2 GHz ZBX IF); rows also carry the bracket from that value to the -35 dBFS noise-floor value.
Full-duty waveform, matched filtering and coherent integration over T with no Doppler walk, range migration or straddle loss (doppler_walk_rows shows when this breaks).
Quasi-monostatic geometry, same antenna gain on TX and RX.
Worst case: the whole body speed is radial.

Bracket chosen to span the published other-group measurements listed in sources; no in-band (2.45 / 3.5 GHz) aspect-averaged total RCS of a quadcopter was found. This repo's simulated levels are not used as RCS.
Used only for the coupled-reference-channel residual; independent LOs of equal noise.

phase_noise_reference_channel.note: This is not a finding: it restates assumption reference_channel_equal_lo_noise by arithmetic. With equal, independent LO noise a coupled TX sample on channel A removes the TX term but adds channel A's RX LO noise, so the phase-noise skirt on channel B changes by +0.0 dB. With other LO noise ratios or a shared LO the result differs. A coupled reference is still useful against additive broadband TX noise and TX distortion. It captures only channel A's phase; array calibration needs a known signal into every RX channel per session (e.g. splitter or the ZBX CAL_LOOPBACK setting).

repo_rotor_reference.note: The meta f_tip_hz (1228.721 Hz) differs from the elevation_sweep_md.py formula value (1229.541 Hz) by -0.0667%. Explanation: the script that writes outputs/report07_three_engines.json (benchmark/report07_three_engine_maps.py) computes the wavelength with c = 3e8 (line 90), while benchmark/elevation_sweep_md.py uses c = 2.998e8 (line 1821). f_tip scales as fc/c, so the quoted constants alone give -0.0667% (2.998e8/3e8 - 1); the residual after removing it is 1.1e-16. Both scripts take the rotation rate from hover_rpm (report07 lines 89 and 92, elevation_sweep_md.py line 1834), so the meta rpm_per_rotor spread (mean 3800.000 rpm) does not enter f_tip_hz. This is a difference in a bookkeeping constant, not in the physics.
